scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: One arrow to go!
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. She's ten, and she loves drawing science diagrams. Tonight, she's finishing a poster about the water cycle for school tomorrow. Her cousin Meera is visiting and helping with the labels. Tara has just one arrow left to draw. She's nearly done, and she's feeling proud!
scenes.dialogue: Just one more arrow, then I’m done!

scenes.label: Lights out
scenes.title: A torch that wants everything
scenes.caption: Suddenly, the power goes out! The flat is dark. Tara grabs the old phone she uses for homework and installs a free torch app. But before it shines, a box pops up. It wants her contacts, location, camera and microphone. A big button says Allow all. Tara just wants some light!
scenes.dialogue: It won’t shine unless I allow everything?

scenes.label: Ask why
scenes.title: What does a torch really need?
scenes.caption: Meera asks: what does a torch need to do its job? Just light! Each request is called a permission. Contacts holds the names and numbers of Tara's friends and family. Location shows where she is. Camera and microphone let an app see and hear. A torch needs none of these.
scenes.dialogue: Why would a torch need my contacts?

scenes.label: Your turn
scenes.title: Switch off what it doesn’t need.
scenes.caption: Your turn. Look at each permission and ask: does a torch need this to shine? Switch off every one it doesn't need, then save your choices. Careful! Allow all is the quickest button, but it would hand over far more than a torch should ever need.
scenes.dialogue: Help me choose. What does a torch need?

scenes.label: Right app, right access
scenes.title: A different job needs different access.
scenes.caption: It worked! The torch shines with no permissions at all. But some apps do need access. A map app needs your location to show the way. A video call needs the camera and microphone. So always ask: what's this app's job? If you're unsure, check with a grown-up first.
scenes.dialogue: So a map really does need location!

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Finished by torchlight
scenes.caption: Tara finishes her last arrow by torchlight, and her poster is done! Meera shows her that permissions can be changed later in the phone's settings too. Now Tara gives each app only what it needs for its job. Your turn: help Tara check three more apps!
scenes.dialogue: Poster done, and my contacts stayed private!
